required_screen_policy: All screens in each of the 16 pinned regular English HTML5 simulations require explicit identity, meaningful interaction/reset, local dependency and layout checks, plus substantive teaching-content review. Existing first-screen samples do not satisfy all-screen review.

format_scope.unsupported_essential_content: Report any essential unsupported activity discovered during screen review as a content blocker; do not silently omit it.

content_blockers: Fourteen named additional screens lack recorded interaction/reset coverage.
Eight simulations need their complete screen inventory recorded from pinned files; saved successful samples do not enumerate it.
All sixteen current runs lack explicit selected-screen identity in their reports; bind each future check to its intended screen.
Substantive content, essential modes and all-screen dependencies remain pending even on sampled screens.

requirements: Actual intended iPhone/iPad/Android/desktop local-file opening workflow.
Touch target usability, orientation and controls on physical devices.
Offline cold start, interaction and reset on those devices.

rerun_workflow.bounded_plan: Reuse existing pins. Inspect one explicitly selected screen at a time, review its entry/actions/state keys, then run its desktop and phone-width interaction/reset checks. Keep the source IDs/hashes unchanged and record each screen identity with its evidence.
rerun_workflow.current_runner_limit: The runner supports one entry sequence per unique simulation ID per manifest. Use separate per-screen manifests/reports with the same source ID; do not fabricate new catalog asset IDs or combine passes without their screen binding.
rerun_workflow.source_availability: Prior temporary source-body cache locations no longer contain the HTML files; recover only from existing verified originals or an authorized build. The detailed reports and screenshots remain available.
